intro: Wrestling may be the oldest sport people still play. Painters in Egypt showed it on tomb walls about 4,000 years ago. Storytellers in Mesopotamia put it in the Epic of Gilgamesh. Festivals in Mongolia, Turkey and Iran still hold it today.

Schools and leagues came much later. Weight classes, padded mats and match clocks are all modern. In Illinois, the IHSA crowned its first state wrestling champions in 1937. Girls got their own state finals in 2022.

In this unit you will line up old evidence and new records. You will be able to say what a date measures. You will tell a legend from a record. You will explain how a state association turned an old practice into a school sport.
bigQuestion: When did wrestling begin, and when did it become a school sport?

timeline.t: Sumerians at Khafajah make a metal figure of two wrestlers
Painters fill tomb walls at Beni Hasan, Egypt, with wrestling pairs
Greek writers date wrestling's start at the Olympic Games
Japan's Nihon Shoki records a legend of an early sumo match
Abraham Lincoln wrestles at New Salem, Illinois
Wrestling is held at the first modern Olympics in Athens
The Illinois High School Association is founded
Gotch beats Hackenschmidt at Dexter Park Pavilion, Chicago
Wrestling's world federation, later United World Wrestling, is founded
The IHSA crowns its first state wrestling champions
Women's freestyle wrestling joins the Olympics in Athens
The IHSA holds its first girls wrestling state finals

test.q: Where are the Beni Hasan wrestling paintings?
test.why: The Beni Hasan tombs are in Middle Egypt on the Nile.

test.q: Who does Gilgamesh wrestle in the epic?
test.why: In the Epic of Gilgamesh, the king wrestles Enkidu.
The palaestra was a Greek building for wrestling practice.

test.q: Which festival includes horse racing, archery and wrestling?
test.why: Naadam, in Mongolia, has those three games.

test.q: Where is oil wrestling's Kırkpınar festival held?
test.why: Kırkpınar is held in Edirne, Turkey.

test.q: Who leads a zurkhaneh with drum and poetry?
test.why: The morshed drums and recites in the zurkhaneh.

test.q: What did the 1896 Olympic wrestling event NOT have?
test.why: There were no weight classes in 1896.

test.q: What was United World Wrestling called before 2014?
test.why: The world federation was called FILA until 2014.
The Illinois High School Association was founded in 1900.

test.q: When did the IHSA crown its first state wrestling champions?
test.why: The first IHSA state wrestling champions were crowned in 1937.

test.q: Where did Abraham Lincoln wrestle as a young man?
test.why: Lincoln wrestled at the village of New Salem around 1831.

test.q: Which match drew crowds to Chicago in 1908?
test.why: Frank Gotch beat George Hackenschmidt in Chicago in 1908.

choices: the first IHSA state wrestling title
test.why: 1937 marks the first IHSA state title, not the start of wrestling.

test.q: When were the first IHSA girls wrestling state finals?
test.why: The IHSA held its first girls state finals in 2022.

test.q: Which is a primary source for the 1937 tournament?
choices: a program printed for the meet
test.why: A program made for the meet is a record from the time.

write.prompt: Someone says, 'Wrestling started in Illinois in 1937.' Is that right? Answer using at least three dated pieces of evidence from this unit, such as the Beni Hasan paintings, Lincoln at New Salem, the 1908 Chicago match or the IHSA records.
tips: Name each piece of evidence and give its date.
Say what each date measures: a first title or a first practice.
Keep legends and records apart, and label which is which.
Use unit words like institution, primary source and weight class.
